Thanks Naomi — quick read and inline.

Quick summary of my recommendations:

1) Defer two infra-heavy items (Low-likelihood throughput uplift) — move to backlog unless we have explicit customer pull.
2) Promote the \"Edge quantization pilot\" to green: smaller team, measurable cost-savings, good for Dedicated customer conversations.
3) Interop pilot: prefer the smaller scope (provider adapter) vs full data-plane integration — keeps slide simple for QBR.

Inline comments in the matrix (see column \"JW-comments\"). Also added a suggested comms timeline (short bullets) in the linked doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QBR-priority-notes

If others agree, I'll update the technical owners and add a short risk bullet for the two deferred items.

—Jonas
